faq.title: Kuch Common Sawaal
faq.subtitle: Jaldi jawab, seedhi baat waste segregation ke baare mein.
faq.q1: WasteWise AI materials ko kaise pehchanta hai?
faq.a1: WasteWise Google Gemini Vision AI ka use karke item ki visual texture, shape, transparency aur recycling symbols ko scan karta hai.
faq.q2: Kachra alag karna India mein itna zaroori kyun hai?
faq.a2: Geela aur sookha kachra mix hone se 80% se zyada recyclable items kharab ho jate hain aur landfill mein toxic gas banate hain.
faq.q3: Hazardous aur E-waste ko kaise dispose karein?
faq.a3: Batteries, CFL bulbs aur purani electronics ko normal bin mein mat daalein. Recycling Centers page se verified center par drop karein.
faq.q4: Eco-Points kya hain aur kaise milte hain?
faq.a4: Har verified scan par aapko 10 se 30 Eco-Points milte hain material recyclability aur CO2 savings ke hisaab se.
faq.q5: Kya main apni local bhasha mein use kar sakta hoon?
faq.a5: Haan! WasteWise 10 languages support karta hai — English, Hindi, Hinglish, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi aur Kannada.
faq.a6: Bilkul, sabhi citizens ke liye poori tarah free hai. Koi registration ya login ki zaroorat nahi hai.

footer.tip_1: Gile aur sookhe kachre ko hamesha alag rakhein taaki organic waste easily compost ban sake.
footer.tip_2: E-waste aur lithium batteries ko kabhi regular dustbin mein na daalein — inhein authorized center bhejein.
footer.tip_3: Plastic bottles aur food containers ko recycle karne se pehle halka sa paani se rinse karein.
footer.tip_4: Single-use plastic packets ko ecobricks ya dry recyclables collection mein dispose karein.
footer.fact_1: 1 ton recycled paper saves 17 trees, 7,000 gallons of water & 4,000 kWh of electricity!
footer.fact_2: Glass takes over 1 million years to decompose, but can be recycled endlessly with zero loss in purity.
footer.fact_3: Recycling one aluminum can saves enough energy to run a TV for three continuous hours.

eco_tips_list.tip: Plastic containers ko fekne se pehle dho lein — bacha hua khana poore polymer batch ko spoil kar deta hai.
Oil lagi pizza box compost mein dalein, paper recycling mein nahi, kyunki oil paper repulping rokta hai.
Lithium-ion batteries ko normal bin mein na dalein. Inhe alag se E-waste center par drop karein.
Plastic bottle fekte waqt dhakkan band rakhein. Modern sorters caps ko PET se alag kar lete hain.
Kitchen wet waste (chilke, chai patti) se sirf 3 se 4 hafton mein rich organic khaad banti hai.
Shredded paper compost bin mein dalein, kyunki iske fibers recycling ke liye bohot chhote hote hain.
Aluminum cans ko crush karke dalein — aluminum infinite times 95% kam energy mein recycle hota hai.
Purane phones aur gadgets recycle karne se pehle factory reset zaroor karein.
CFL aur tube lights mein mercury hota hai. Inhe dhyan se wrap karke Hazardous waste mein dalein.
Purane saaf kapde zarooratmand ko donate karein ya safai ke poonchhe banakar reuse karein.
